about_the_game:
Vet Van Organizer is a strategy puzzle game where order, focus, and sweet chaos come together! 🧩

You’ve inherited your grandmother’s old vet van, and now it’s your job to keep things running.
Every day, new animals arrive, and your task is to place them correctly!
But be careful, some species simply do not get along! 🐕🚫🐈
If you put rival animals side by side, chaos begins.

Each of the 18 animal types has its own size and personality, and some are even VIPs! 💎
VIP animals have special needs, which makes finding the right spot a little harder but even more rewarding.

Across more than 100 handcrafted levels, you’ll face limited space, oddly shaped crates, and adorable yet stubborn animals.
Improve your strategy step by step and turn your vet van into a true organization masterpiece.

With relaxing music 🎶, a minimal design 🧘‍♀️, and cute animal sounds 🐾,
Vet Van Organizer invites you to experience the most satisfying kind of order. 💖

🌟 Key Features

• 🐾 18 unique animal types, each with its own shape and personality
• 💎 VIP animals that require extra care and attention
• 🚫 Keep rival species apart with smart placement
• 🚐 Over 100 levels of increasing organizational challenge
• 🧩 A true “sort and fit” puzzle experience
• 🎶 Calm music and a cozy atmosphere
• 🌸 Play entirely at your own pace with no time pressure
